headline: Turning more of Cyber Care's enquiries into clients
told: You want to turn more of your enquiries into sales
Most of your work comes from referrals and word of mouth
You sell to businesses and to the public, with a team of 2 to 10 people

today.leak: Every button goes to one general contact page
Nothing about users, setup or urgency
No reply time, so they keep shopping around
No follow-up, so it goes quiet

future.note: With a free IT check to book
Every enquiry and quote in one place
Quotes chased a few days later

noticed: Every button on the site goes to the same contact page, which asks for a name, an email, a subject and a message
Nothing says how quickly someone will hear back
Your WhatsApp number is only in the footer, and for an IT problem that's normally the first thing people reach for
Your pricing is clear and published, which is a real strength once the enquiry is in front of you
planTitle: How we would go about it

plan.title: A proper front door
plan.body: One quote form that asks the few things you need to know: how many users, what they're running now and how urgent it is. A WhatsApp button on every page, and a line that says when they'll hear back.

plan.title: A fast first reply
plan.body: Every enquiry answered within minutes in your hours, with an easy way to book a free IT check, so they don't carry on shopping around.

plan.title: Nothing goes quiet
plan.body: Every enquiry and quote sits in one simple pipeline, and quotes get followed up a few days later instead of being left to chase themselves.

plan.title: More than referrals
plan.body: Once the front door is sorted, we reach out to local businesses with 10 to 50 staff that should be using someone like you, in your name, so you're not waiting on word of mouth.

timeline.label: Front door, first reply and pipeline
timeline.body: You approve everything as we go

timeline.label: Outreach to local businesses
timeline.body: Normally when the new conversations start coming in

timeline.label: Follow-ups and tuning
timeline.body: What the numbers show, fixed every month

worth.body: So even a couple more clients closed a year makes a real difference, and they pay you every month after that.

next.title: Talk it through on Thursday
next.body: We talk on Thursday 13 November. It would really help to know roughly how many enquiries and quotes you get in a month, and how many of those turn into clients, so I can show you exactly where the gap is.
